summary: Seedcamp is active. The old /apply/ URL now returns 404, but Seedcamp’s official site links “Pitch Us” to an open Typeform saying it reviews every submission. No cohort dates or application deadlines are published.

proposed_event.name: Seedcamp Rolling Applications
proposed_event.description: European seed fund backing early founders with $350K-$1M checks, hands-on support and founder community access.

dates.date_range_text: Rolling pitch submissions; Seedcamp says it reviews every submission and aims to run its end-to-end investment process within two weeks of meeting founders.

sources.title: Seedcamp: Pitch Us
sources.supports: Official pitch form title and copy; states Seedcamp has partnered with 500+ companies, wants to hear from ambitious founders, and reviews every submission.

sources.title: FAQs - Seedcamp
sources.supports: Official FAQ supports first cheque size of $350K-$1M, first-backer positioning, investment stage, sector-agnostic software-first focus, Europe/Israel focus, founder support, and two-week investment process target.

sources.title: Seedcamp Nation - Seedcamp
sources.supports: Official Seedcamp Nation page supports founder community, in-house team support, network, events, candidate introductions, and early-stage partner positioning.

sources.title: Contact us - Seedcamp
sources.supports: Official contact page supports Seedcamp's London address at 12 Little Portland Street, London W1W 8BJ, United Kingdom, and footer Pitch Us link.

sources.title: Apply page - Seedcamp
sources.supports: The originally supplied official apply URL currently returns a 404 Page not found, so the current official Pitch Us path is used instead.

notes: No exact 2026 application deadline, cohort dates, program start/end, demo day, or timezone were published on the official pages checked.
The current official site footer links Pitch Us via https://seedcamp.com/out/f6-startup-details, which redirects to https://seedcamp.typeform.com/to/ez4GLW0I.
The old existing FounderCal description mentioning €100K-€200K for roughly 7% equity appears stale versus Seedcamp’s current FAQ, which says the first cheque is usually $350K-$1M.
Classified as accelerator to fit the available taxonomy, though Seedcamp describes itself as Europe’s seed fund rather than a fixed-date accelerator cohort.
